description: The COMPLETE interactive-state inventory for the whole site. This is a closed list verified by `grep -rno 'hover:[a-z-]*' src/`.

hoverGate.effect: every hover: utility compiles inside @media (hover: hover), matching the v4 original

RULES: There is NO hover, active or focus state on ANY button, card, logo, image, pill, stat or form control anywhere on the site.
Computed `outline: none` and `box-shadow: none` on every form control. The only focus affordance is the UA default on native controls.
There is EXACTLY ONE transitioning element inside <main> on a content route: the BadgeLink eyebrow pill.
MessageCard's category badge is VISUALLY IDENTICAL to BadgeLink but has NO hover and NO transition. Same visual, different behaviour — never propagate BadgeLink's hover to it.
A GENERATOR MUST NOT INVENT A HOVER, ACTIVE OR FOCUS STATE. Adding one is a fidelity regression, not an improvement.
